_comment: What GET /api/boots returns, read by BOTH sides. Written by agent/src/runstate.rs (`recent_boots`) and served by agent/src/web/mod.rs (`api_boots`); read by resources/panel-react/src/hooks/useBootHistory.ts and drawn by RestartHistoryCard. THREE PROMISES TRAVEL IN THIS FILE, and each is asserted from both ends rather than assumed: records are NEWEST FIRST (the card renders the first VISIBLE entries as the latest, so a reverse here would show the OLDEST restarts as the newest); the first run of an install has NO uptime_secs and NO gap_secs — absent, never zero, because 'ran 0s' is a claim about a run that never existed; and ts_ms is unix MILLISECONDS, the unit every panel clock uses. The panel's defences against a body it cannot use — a record with no stamp, a kind it does not know — are its own test's business and are NOT in here, so this file stays exactly what the device emits.
